_doc: Human verdicts on ditto marks the gate gave up: the missing half of results/ditto_review_*.
PIPELINE.md #1 asks for the verdict to be recorded per volume, and nothing ever did. The queue
is derived (ia_volume_to_jsonl.ditto_lead_candidates); the verdict is not.
`confirmed` marks go to the sweep as `confirmed_marks`: they skip the share floor (and the 5%
digit floor) but not the name-follower ratio, which is a property of the data. survey_harvest.py
--rederive applies them; the harvest records them as `harvest.filtered.ditto_confirmed`.
`rejected` keeps the reason, so a regenerated queue can be read against it.
Letter-shaped marks (`ii`, `n`, `it`) are admitted only from here, never by the gate,
because `n` is also "near" in a wrapped address. A mark is confirmed for the volumes the
review page showed it in (results/ditto_review_letters.html: 500+ lines there).
Each verdict was made on the page images: data_prep/ditto_review_page.py --ids <volumes>.
`ambiguous` marks were reviewed and are not admitted: the crops show them as the ditto on some
lines and as something else on others (`li` is also the `h` marker opening a wrapped line). They
are left out of later review pages like decided marks.

rejected.&: not a ditto (hadro): mostly a business name or address wrapped onto a second line, or a ditto mark followed by an ampersand whose ditto the OCR dropped
rejected.4: the same case: 9 of 10 crops are a printed '" &' with the & read as 4 and the ditto dropped, the 10th a wrapped '& Liquor Co'. Admitting it would turn 'Gluck & Mandel' into 'Gluck Mandel'
rejected.h: the residence marker at the start of a wrapped line ('h Newark N J'), not a ditto (hadro)

trowsgeneraldire1915trow.note: Two reviews. The first (14 punctuation/digit marks, 33,477 scoped lines) missed the letter-shaped readings of the same printed '"', which lead 44.5% of the volume's lines; the second (results/ditto_review_letters.html) added 8 of them. All are OCR readings of one glyph (PIPELINE.md #18).
